name: Hotel Cappella
beschreibung:
The Natura Vitalis Hotel Cappella is a family-run 4-star hotel in the Neder district of Neustift in the Stubaital. Hosts Sonja and Martin Eberharter place value on a respectful approach to nature, which is reflected in the vital cuisine with regional, seasonal and sustainable ingredients. Many herbs come from the hotel's own herb garden, which host Sonja Eberharter tends and uses in the kitchen and wellness area.

The wellness area serves regeneration and relaxation and uses the beneficial properties of Alpine herbs. The garden and terraces offer views of the Stubai Alps. As a herb expert, Sonja Eberharter also personally accompanies guests on hikes. The hotel is quietly located on the edge of Neustift, with a bus stop in the immediate vicinity. In the low season, the Stubai Super Card is included, which covers among other things mountain railways and buses in the valley.
